title: Cairn 90-minute recording — first-pass shortlist
source_type: 24 contact sheets, 384 still images, approximately 14.14 s sampling gap; motion/audio must be confirmed separately
legacy_v1_note: Legacy V1 range database is not included in this report; the existing editor checks it separately.

concepts.title: A mountain climb turns into a cartoon nightmare
concepts.hook_idea: Why is there a rainbow tunnel in a climbing game?
concepts.visible_evidence: A rainbow road appears around 00:43:01; cartoon figures and a laboratory-like room are visible until about 00:44:40.
concepts.confidence: high for visuals; exact transition requires video
concepts.caution: The existing V2 edit reserves 00:43:09–00:43:13, so keep all new cuts outside it.

concepts.title: The unexpected calm between climbs
concepts.hook_idea: After all that climbing, this is where I ended up.
concepts.visible_evidence: A close-up of the climber indoors, drinking or preparing items at around 00:35:28–00:37:07, with inventory overlays.
concepts.confidence: medium; static menu screens might not retain viewers
concepts.caution: Confirm motion and game context; avoid claiming a scripted narrative not shown.

concepts.title: The mountain nearly disappears in the storm
concepts.hook_idea: The visibility got so bad I could barely see the wall.
concepts.visible_evidence: Snow and ice climbing across 01:05:50–01:07:17; a sudden bright, multicolored sequence appears around 01:07:31.
concepts.confidence: high for weather/visual transformation; danger needs verification
concepts.caution: Do not claim an avalanche or a death without reviewing actual motion.

concepts.title: Crossing the glowing ice with two climbing picks
concepts.hook_idea: This ice section looks impossible to cross.
concepts.visible_evidence: The player clings to bright icy formations near 01:17:40–01:18:51, with ice-tool prompts onscreen.
concepts.confidence: medium-high for traverse; close call unverified
concepts.caution: The already-reserved 01:17:33–01:17:38 segment must be excluded.

concepts.title: At the top of Cairn: an extraordinary landscape
concepts.hook_idea: After all that climbing, this is what the summit looks like.
concepts.visible_evidence: A luminous snowy summit ridge and star field from about 01:23:05–01:25:12; the character appears to reach the top.
concepts.confidence: high for summit view; chronology needs verification
concepts.caution: The already-reserved 01:24:45–01:24:50 segment must be excluded. This is a major ending spoiler.

concepts.title: Cairn's ending goes beyond the mountain
concepts.hook_idea: I thought reaching the peak was the end. Then this happened.
concepts.visible_evidence: The character floats amid stars around 01:25:26 onward; colorful comet-like streaks and Cairn credits follow around 01:27–01:29.
concepts.confidence: high for visual ending sequence; interpretive meaning unknown
concepts.caution: Major finale spoilers; review actual video before describing the ending's meaning.
